import sys, calendar
sys.path.insert\(0, '.'\)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from src.memory.models import Reminder

def _next_occurrence\(reminder\):
    rule = reminder.recurrence_rule
    if not rule:
        return None
    base = reminder.remind_at
    if rule == 'daily':
        nxt = base + timedelta\(days=1\)
    elif rule == 'weekly':
        nxt = base + timedelta\(weeks=1\)
    elif rule == 'monthly':
        month = base.month + 1
        year = base.year + \(month - 1\) // 12
        month = \(\(month - 1\) % 12\) + 1
        max_day = calendar.monthrange\(year, month\)[1]
        day = min\(base.day, max_day\)
        nxt = base.replace\(year=year, month=month, day=day\)
    else:
        return None
    if reminder.recurrence_end and nxt > reminder.recurrence_end:
        return None
    return nxt

base = datetime\(2025, 6, 15, 9, 0, 0\)
def make_r\(rule, end=None\):
    return Reminder\(id=1, content='x', remind_at=base, sent=False, created_at=base,
                    recurrence_rule=rule, recurrence_end=end\)

nxt = _next_occurrence\(make_r\('daily'\)\)
assert nxt == datetime\(2025, 6, 16, 9\), nxt
print\(f'daily OK: {nxt.date\(\)}'\)

nxt = _next_occurrence\(make_r\('weekly'\)\)
assert nxt == datetime\(2025, 6, 22, 9\), nxt
print\(f'weekly OK: {nxt.date\(\)}'\)

nxt = _next_occurrence\(make_r\('monthly'\)\)
assert nxt == datetime\(2025, 7, 15, 9\), nxt
print\(f'monthly OK: {nxt.date\(\)}'\)

base2 = datetime\(2025, 1, 31, 9\)
r2 = Reminder\(id=2, content='x', remind_at=base2, sent=False, created_at=base2, recurrence_rule='monthly'\)
nxt2 = _next_occurrence\(r2\)
assert nxt2 == datetime\(2025, 2, 28, 9\), nxt2
print\(f'monthly clamp Jan31->Feb28 OK: {nxt2.date\(\)}'\)

r3 = make_r\('daily', end=datetime\(2025, 6, 15, 8\)\)
assert _next_occurrence\(r3\) is None
print\('recurrence_end stops it: OK'\)

print\('All recurrence tests passed!'\)
" 2>&1)
